categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes address selection in addrman (`src/addrman.cpp`) and carries the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a severe statistical bias in peer address selection within addrman buckets, improving peer diversity and eclipse resistance. The PR notes that in sparse buckets, linear scanning skewed selection heavily toward entries following empty positions, reaching '95.3% versus 4.7% in a bucket with only two entries'.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The changes in `src/test/addrman_tests.cpp` and `src/test/fuzz/addrman.cpp` are specific to verifying addrman behavior rather than modifying shared test framework machinery.
categories.rationale: Tests of a particular area belong to that area rather than the general test infrastructure category.
